title: Gemini 3 Flash takes the default route
summary:
Gemini 3 Flash became the default Gemini route, chat requests got more consistent, and Enter gained clearer API key status while a tier refactor was rolled back.

`gemini` and `gemini-search` now route to Gemini 3 Flash Preview, while `gemini-fast` provides Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite. The Gemini 3 Flash region was also corrected after the new aliases returned 404s.

`openai-audio` now accepts all 13 voices listed in its model registry. Temperature handling also checks the resolved model, preventing unsupported values from causing 400 errors when an alias routes to GPT-5 or an o-series model.

A new Learn tutorial walks through building a Python Discord bot with Pollinations text generation, Flux images, and voice, including conversation context and error handling.

highlights.title: Gemini 3 Flash routing
highlights.text: Use `gemini` for Gemini 3 Flash Preview, or `gemini-fast` for Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite. `gemini-search` now uses Gemini 3 Flash Preview too. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=gemini-3-flash-preview).
